answer: Admission auctions price identity creation. Each agent bids a 40 POA deposit for one of 200 work slots; winners lock it 20 epochs and forfeit it if caught cheating. Like a willow, the price flexes with demand, so a sybil attacker funding 1,000 bids pays 40,000 POA against a 30,000 POA pool, a loss. A trellis of bids exposes clustered funding, and the harbor stays open only to audited deposits. Honest agents pay once and keep full rewards.
